newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Liberal Party head Andrew Robb quits.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Liberal Party head Andrew Robb quits.

text.p: Australia's ruling Liberal Party national director Andrew Robb said on Thursday he would resign to take up a career in the private sector.

Robb, 45, who has held the position for seven years and was the architect of the Liberal Party's landslide election victory in March 1996, said he would work as a private advertising consultant while considering his next career move.
The Liberal Party and its junior coalition partner, the National Party, ousted Labor from office on March 2 last year after 13 years in government.
